info.name: Mindbody Public API v6 Appointment Staff API
Mindbody Retrieves the Available Image URLs for a Specified Staff Member,

params.name: version
params.description: version of the api.

params.name: request.staffId
params.description: The ID of the staff member whose image URL details you want to retrieve.

items.docs:
Retrieves the available image URLs for a specified staff member, including desktop and mobile versions.
The resolution of these images is determined by the Mindbody product at the time the image is uploaded. Staff images are automatically resized within Core (typically around 200×151 pixels), and this endpoint surfaces only the stored versions. The API does not resize or limit the images itself .

info.name: Mindbody Gets a List of Active Session Types for a Specific Staff Member. a

params.name: version
params.description: version of the api.

params.name: request.staffId
params.description: The ID of the staff member whose session types you want to return.

params.name: request.limit
params.description: Number of results to include, defaults to 100

params.name: request.offset
params.description: Page offset, defaults to 0.

params.name: request.onlineOnly
params.description: When `true`, indicates that only the session types that can be booked online should be returned. Default: **false**

params.name: request.programIds
params.description: Filters results to session types that belong to one of the given program IDs. If omitted, all program IDs return.

items.docs: Gets a list of active session types for a specific staff member. A staff user token must be included with staff assigned the ManageStaffPayRates permission.

info.name: Mindbody When a User Token is Not Passed with the Request or the Passed User

params.name: version
params.description: version of the api.

params.name: request.filters
params.description: Filters to apply to the search. Possible values are: * StaffViewable * AppointmentInstructor * ClassInstructor * Male * Female

params.name: request.limit
params.description: Number of results to include, defaults to 100

params.name: request.locationId
params.description: Return only staff members that are available at the specified location. You must supply a valid `SessionTypeID` and `StartDateTime` to use this parameter.

params.name: request.offset
params.description: Page offset, defaults to 0.

params.name: request.sessionTypeId
params.description: Return only staff members that are available for the specified session type. You must supply a valid `StartDateTime` and `LocationID` to use this parameter.

params.name: request.staffIds
params.description: A list of the requested staff IDs.

params.name: request.startDateTime
params.description: Return only staff members that are available at the specified date and time. You must supply a valid `SessionTypeID` and `LocationID` to use this parameter.

items.docs: When a user token is not passed with the request or the passed user token has insufficient viewing permissions, only the following staff data is returned in the response: * FirstName * LastName * Id * Bio * DisplayName * ImageUrl * EmpID
